projects.name: Raleigh Miami Beach expansion plan
projects.scale: adding more than 66,000 sqft of floor area
projects.summary: Nahla Capital is seeking approval from the Miami Beach City Commission to expand the Raleigh Miami Beach redevelopment. The plan involves comprehensive plan and code amendments to increase the floor area ratio, which would add over 66,000 square feet to the project.

projects.name: Marina Village
projects.summary: Forest Development was selected by Riviera Beach city council to undertake a $556.1 million phased development at Marina Village. The project encompasses 12 acres of city-owned waterfront, forming part of a larger 80-acre site intended for significant redevelopment.

projects.name: Portofino Hollywood
projects.summary: Related Group secured approval from the Hollywood City Commission for a revised plan for its Portofino Hollywood beachfront residential development. The project was modified to include workforce housing rentals, utilizing the state's Live Local Act for expedited approval.
